outcome: Major: invalid representation-theoretic foundation; two additional Minor scope/estimate issues; no counterexample to main classification

findings.claim: All weights even iff highest weight even; compact-stabilizer characterization of all cone interiors
findings.evidence: SL3 Sym2 has invariant PSD cone with odd non-extremal coroot weights and no greatest weight for printed order. SL2 Sym4 q=x^4+y^4 is interior of nonnegative cone but infinitesimal stabilizer has rank3 constraints and dimension0. Fourth-power cone and all-nonnegative cone are distinct.
findings.counterevidence: Actual classification uses extremal weight test; actual Levi modules are symmetric cone models. Benoist Prop4.7 uses highest restricted weight only. No final classification counterexample.
findings.impact: Invalid general theorem invoked in classification and uniqueness justification. Replace definitions and establish specific cone properties. Related defects counted together in one foundation finding.
findings.certainty: Demonstrated by explicit finite-dimensional counterexamples and primary-source comparison

findings.claim: All long restricted-root spaces are real one-dimensional
findings.evidence: Sp(4,C) as a real group: long simple root2e2 has real root space span(E24,iE24), dimension2.
findings.counterevidence: Theorem3.4 separately imposes multiplicity1; this group excluded.

findings.claim: Uniform global quadratic BCH remainder for all root parameters

findings.counterevidence: Polynomial BCH is quadratic on bounded neighborhood. Prop10.10 transfers local estimate; linear projection bound handles large X. Complete repair of Prop10.22(1) given.

focused_acceptance.reason: M01: SL3 Sym2 distinguishes highest-weight parity from every weight and matches an actual classified Levi module; SL2 binary quartic is interior but has zero-dimensional stabilizer, contradicting the full interior assertion. Benoist uses highest restricted weight, not these stronger claims; core classification/uniqueness dependency supports Major while final classification is not refuted. M02: Sp(4,C) as real has a2-dimensional long root space; multiplicity1 is separately imposed downstream, so Minor. M03: valid SL4 reduced-word parameters give BCH cubic t3E14/3, disproving a global quadratic bound; local BCH+properness and large-radius linear estimate repair actual tangent-cone use, so Minor.
focused_acceptance.verification_scope: One focused acceptance of existing reported/excluded/known Problems and scoped claims; no fresh whole-paper review.
